name: Smart Goal Builder
description: Transforms vague aspirations into SMART goals with Specific criteria, Measurable metrics, Attainability assessment, Relevance check, and Time-bound deadlines with interim milestones. Use when the user has a goal idea but it lacks clarity, wants to turn a wish into an actionable plan, or needs to define measurable success criteria for a personal objective. Do NOT use for organizational goal setting (use business strategy skills), habit formation or behavior change coaching (use health-wellness skills), or OKR creation (use `okr-builder` instead).
